weakness: Contractor agents (about 70% of users) sign in to email and the transaction platform with a password only
remediation_plan: Enforce MFA for all contractor accounts through the identity provider; block legacy authentication protocols; mobile application management on personal devices
milestones: 2026-10-15 licenses bought and 10-agent pilot; 2026-11-15 all agents enrolled; 2026-11-30 MFA enforced and legacy protocols off
resources_required: $14K per year MFA and mobile application management licenses

weakness: No written disbursement verification procedure; payoffs, lien payments, and changed instructions not independently verified; no role training
remediation_plan: Written disbursement verification procedure with independent callback for every payoff, payee change, and proceeds wire; role training for Closing Services; monthly sample of verification records
milestones: 2026-10-15 procedure approved by the Closing Services Manager and the Broker of Record; 2026-10-31 in use and staff trained; 2026-11-30 first monthly sample

weakness: No monitoring of sign-in risk, mailbox forwarding rules, or bulk downloads
source: P07 (SI-04 objectives); P03 G-021; P01 R-001 R-003
remediation_plan: MSP alerting on risky sign-ins, new forwarding rules, and bulk downloads, with 24x7 triage; weekly review by the IT Manager
milestones: 2026-11-30 alert rules live; 2026-12-31 weekly review operating
resources_required: $9K per year MSP EDR and monitoring

weakness: Backups share the production account and administrators and are not immutable; no independent backup of email and transaction data
source: P07 (CP-09 objectives); P04 finding 2; P01 R-006
remediation_plan: Separate backup account with immutable retention; third-party backup of email and transaction platform data; copy of portal code and documentation
milestones: 2026-10-31 design approved; 2026-12-31 migrated and SaaS backup running
resources_required: $7K per year backup storage and SaaS backup service

weakness: Single approver for wires from the sales and property management escrow accounts
source: P07 (AC-05 objectives); P03 G-051; P01 R-033
remediation_plan: Dual approval on every escrow account wire (bank setting); document separation of duties for all three accounts
milestones: 2026-10-15 bank settings changed and documented

weakness: External automatic forwarding allowed; five contractor mailboxes forwarding to personal webmail
remediation_plan: Block external auto-forwarding by transport rule; remove the five rules and review what was forwarded; alert on new rules (POAM-003)
milestones: 2026-09-05 five rules removed; 2026-09-30 external forwarding blocked

weakness: Audit records never reviewed; default log retention
remediation_plan: Weekly review of sign-in, mailbox, and cloud audit logs; export to a workspace with 1-year retention
milestones: 2026-11-30 log export; 2026-12-31 weekly review operating

weakness: No contingency plan test and no restore test
remediation_plan: Quarterly restore tests of the portal, integration service, and SaaS backups; annual contingency tabletop after the plan is written
milestones: 2026-12-31 first restore test; 2027-03-31 second restore test

weakness: Account types undocumented; stale contractor accounts; no account monitoring or reviews; shared storage device credential
remediation_plan: Document account types; remove stale accounts; quarterly access reviews by managers
milestones: 2026-10-31 stale accounts removed; 2026-12-31 first quarterly review complete

weakness: Contractor agent departures not reported on time; no security terms or departure notice duty in the agent agreement
remediation_plan: Same-day disable on departure; weekly license roster reconciliation; security and notice terms in the agent agreement
milestones: 2026-10-31 same-day process and weekly reconciliation live; 2027-01-31 agreement addendum signed

weakness: Office-wide visibility in the transaction platform lets every agent open every office transaction
remediation_plan: Team-based visibility in SYS-01; quarterly review of broker and coordinator roles
milestones: 2026-11-30 role design approved; 2026-12-31 configured

weakness: No training for contractor agents; no BEC content; no phishing exercises
remediation_plan: BEC and wire fraud training for employees and contractors; quarterly phishing exercises; use the March 2026 near miss as a case study
milestones: 2026-11-30 training live; 2026-12-31 first phishing exercise

weakness: No service provider inventory, contract security terms for 3 of 6 key providers, or ongoing monitoring; closing software recovery commitments undocumented
remediation_plan: Inventory and risk tiering; security addendum at renewal; annual SOC report review for tier-1 providers, starting with the closing software vendor
milestones: 2026-12-31 inventory and tiering; 2027-03-31 addenda and closing software review

weakness: No vulnerability scanning or penetration testing
remediation_plan: Monthly authenticated scans by the MSP with remediation deadlines; annual external and portal penetration test
milestones: 2026-11-15 penetration test complete; 2026-11-30 first monthly scan

weakness: Closing packages emailed as unencrypted attachments
remediation_plan: Closing documents only through the portal; enforced encryption rule for emails with Social Security or account numbers
milestones: 2026-11-30 encryption rule live; 2026-12-31 portal-only delivery

weakness: Unencrypted storage device holds 2016-2022 closing files
remediation_plan: Apply the retention schedule; move retained files to encrypted cloud storage; destroy the device with a certificate
milestones: 2027-01-31 files sorted under the schedule; 2027-02-28 device destroyed

weakness: Legacy protocols enabled; DMARC at monitor only; no configuration baseline
remediation_plan: Disable legacy protocols (with POAM-001); move DMARC to reject; register look-alike domains; document the tenant baseline
milestones: 2026-10-31 DMARC quarantine; 2026-11-30 DMARC reject and baseline documented

weakness: No incident handling capability at assessment time; near miss undocumented
remediation_plan: Adopt POL-03 and the P08 BEC runbook; confirm bank fraud-desk and underwriter contacts; document the near miss; escrow dispute procedure; notification determination worksheet and FTC notice template tested in the tabletop; ransomware and lost-device runbooks
milestones: 2026-09-21 POL-03 and P08 approved; 2026-10-31 bank and underwriter contacts, near-miss record, and escrow dispute procedure; 2026-12-15 worksheet, template, and tabletop; 2027-03-31 additional runbooks

weakness: No reporting time frame or line; contractors not required to report
remediation_plan: Incident line; reporting duty in POL-03 4.2, the agent agreement, and contractor training
milestones: 2026-09-21 POL-03 approved; 2026-12-31 agent agreement addendum and training complete

weakness: Branch Office file room unlocked; no key log or key inventory; alarm code and locks not changed
remediation_plan: Lock the file room with a key log; inventory and rekey; individual alarm codes

weakness: Shared credentials on the storage device and a shared MSP administrator account
remediation_plan: Named MSP accounts with phishing-resistant MFA and source restrictions; named storage device accounts until it is retired (POAM-016)
milestones: 2026-11-30 MSP named accounts; 2026-12-31 storage device accounts

weakness: Risk assessment review and update cycle not yet operated
remediation_plan: Annual reassessment each August (POL-01 4.3)
milestones: 2026-09-21 POL-01 approved; 2027-08-31 first reassessment

weakness: Closing Communications Portal built without secure development practices and never tested
remediation_plan: Secure development standard in the developer contract; fix critical and high penetration test findings; web application firewall; stronger client sign-in
milestones: 2026-11-15 test findings received; 2026-12-31 critical and high findings fixed and standard signed

weakness: No retention and disposal schedule; information kept indefinitely
remediation_plan: Retention schedule reconciling the two-year disposal rule with Florida record duties; annual purge
milestones: 2026-12-31 draft schedule; 2027-03-31 approved and first purge

weakness: No written annual report to the majority owner; Qualified Individual designation not signed
remediation_plan: Designation letter signed by the majority owner; first written annual report under 314.4(i)
milestones: 2026-10-31 designation letter; 2026-12-15 first annual report

weakness: No change management for the portal and integration service
remediation_plan: Change procedure with test evidence and approval; second reviewer for changes to wire instruction display

weakness: No inventory of where customer information is stored; contractor devices and paper records not inventoried
remediation_plan: Data inventory covering systems, paper records, contractor devices, and service providers; annual update (POL-04 4.5)
milestones: 2026-11-30 draft inventory; 2026-12-31 approved

weakness: Earnest money deposit wire instructions sent to buyers by ordinary email; deposit verification requests sent to unverified contacts
remediation_plan: Deposit wire instructions only from the Closing Communications Portal with a callback script; deposit verification as a tracked task in SYS-01 sent to a holder contact verified from an independent source; agent training
milestones: 2026-10-31 callback script and tracked task live; 2026-11-30 portal-only deposit instructions and agent training complete
resources_required: Staff time; included in POAM-012 training
